method: Explicit NPC/party/encounter fixtures. Production Game.update, actual keyboard movement and battle selection render the real NPC, followers, portraits and timed actions. No screenshot pixels, pose overrides or battle damage are assigned. The separate pose/gait inspection uses main’s installed drawHero DEV hook.

techs.name: Rift Cleave
techs.description: Sweep a crescent through the enemy line.

techs.name: Salt Mend
techs.description: An old coast remedy: steady breath, warm hands.

techs.name: Beat Break
techs.description: A precise cut interrupts the enemy’s rhythm.

techs.name: Horizon Sever
techs.description: Three steps and a single decisive edge.

techs.name: Prism Cut
techs.description: Vex splits the edge into a fan of refracted blades.

techs.name: Harbor Break
techs.description: Rune launches Kaida from the shield into a plunging cut.

techs.name: Concord Dawn
techs.description: Steel, signal and shelter meet in a single sunrise.

log.text: Weapons drawn. Keep the signal alive.
